SuiteInformation.Title: Ionity Quick Check
SuiteInformation.Description: A five-minute Ionity Bench smoke test: IO-Core on all cores, IO-Mem Triad, IO-Telemetry-SQLite ingest and IO-JSON-MQTT small messages. Use it to sanity-check a freshly imaged edge node or to get a first comparable number from any machine. Fully offline; only a C compiler and Python 3 are needed.
SuiteInformation.Maintainer: Johan Wilhelm van Antwerp - Ionity (Pty) Ltd
